reproduction.rationale: Matched assistance is declared in access-conditions.v1.json, but authentic common/code manifests, evaluation identity, runtime/exposure and finite budgets are not yet frozen. Authenticate S11 thirty-subject identities, complete parcel/PC/context coverage and source array/trial alignment; the main twenty-nine-subject MI/II cohort is a different support. Recover original gCORR/gSCR producer, exact PC/subsample/parcel/participant aggregation and all published signed stimulus-decoding arrays; no favorable time/region/PC summary may substitute. Reconcile source MATLAB resampling, missing-value behavior and fit-only 1e12 scaling; retain prospective corrected branches separately. Authenticate historical fold/subsample realization or qualify a provenance-complete source-protocol stochastic rerun with published-result calibration and candidate/author pairing; original row-level trial overlap and all-trial PCA remain disclosed. Set a complete-support paired participant comparison, meaningful effect and reproduction criterion plus exact common artifacts, author-code access and finite resource/search budgets before activation. The selected source endpoint retains a complete metric array without an authenticated original scalar reduction. Existing improvement/v1 scalar admission cannot qualify this full-panel comparison; an additive full-panel comparator/admission engine and reviewed complete-support criterion remain required. No new mean, win count or convenient scalar is substituted.
